Title: Support for Windows 10 Universal Apps, Power BI dashboard, new troubleshooting feature, and more

Body.Content:
Since Azure Mobile Engagement became generally available a few months ago, we have released:
  • An updated Windows Universal SDK with support for Windows 10 Universal Apps
  • A Power BI Content Pack
  • Features and documentation for troubleshooting
Read all about these and other updates in the following blog post: Making the most of Azure Mobile Engagement.
